## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new functionality)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] docs (docs only)
- [ ] refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] eval (evaluation-only change)
- [ ] paper (paper-only change)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CLAUDE.md` and `docs/PROGRESS.md` before opening it.
- [ ] I added/updated **unit tests** for any functional change.
- [ ] `make lint` is clean locally.
- [ ] `make test` passes locally.
- [ ] I updated `docs/PROGRESS.md` with a new log entry.
- [ ] I did **not** commit secrets, `.env`, kubeconfigs, or large datasets.
- [ ] If this PR touches RCA / detection / evaluation, the change is reproducible from a scenario id + seed.
- [ ] I followed the Conventional Commits format in my commit messages.
- [ ] I added an entry to `CHANGELOG.md` under the `Unreleased` section.
